title: Jewelled Apricot Paratha
description: A sweet and savory flatbread filled with jewelled fruits and spices, perfect for a breakfast or snack.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Roll out the paratha sheet to a thin circle.
Spread the apricot jam evenly over the center of the paratha, leaving a 1-inch border.
Sprinkle the chopped jewelled fruits over the jam.
Drizzle the melted ghee or butter over the fruits.
Sprinkle cardamom powder and powdered sugar over the top.
Fold the 1-inch border over the filling to create a seal.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the paratha is golden brown and crispy.
Flip and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Cut into wedges and serve warm.
